# Cast receiver settings. Edit this file on the boot partition (FAT, readable
# from any computer) and reboot. Lines are KEY=value; # starts a comment.

# The name shown on HDMI and to AirPlay/DLNA senders. Empty: "Cast-<serial>".
NAME=

# Wi-Fi: set WIFI_SSID (and WIFI_PSK for WPA2/WPA3-personal) to join a network
# as well as Ethernet. WIFI_COUNTRY is the two-letter regulatory domain.
WIFI_SSID=
WIFI_PSK=
WIFI_COUNTRY=US

# Receivers to run: 1 on, 0 off.
AIRPLAY=1
DLNA=1

# AirPlay: a password senders must enter to connect. Empty: none.
AIRPLAY_PASSWORD=
# Extra UxPlay options, appended to the built-in ones (see `uxplay -h`).
UXPLAY_EXTRA=

# 1: a root shell on the serial console (115200 8N1; CM4: GPIO14/15,
# Pi 5: the 3-pin debug UART).
DEBUG_SHELL=0
